scenes.score_intent: Warm pastoral Americana for sun-kissed Santa Clara estate, gentle acoustic guitar and soft strings with light woodwinds, leisurely 80–90 BPM, opens hushed and idyllic over lawns and veranda, brightens with playful cello and harp glints as Buck moves among the dogs, swells into a brief sunlit crest of full strings and sparkling percussion on the cement-tank plunge, then eases back to twilight warmth and a quiet fading pastoral cadence over stables and orchards
scenes.dynamics_arc: Intensity rises gently from clip 1 through clip 2, peaks on the tank plunge at clip 3, then releases through the twilight escort and settles soft on the rear grounds in clips 4–5.
scenes.timing: Sparse opening 0–8s, gradual lift through mid-scene, crest around the plunge ~18–28s, warm decrescendo to end ~45s
scenes.diegetic_sound: Birdsong, distant dogs yapping, water splash and spray shake, soft footfalls on path, faint stable and orchard ambience
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No percussion hits or dark motifs; avoid any tension stingers that foreshadow kidnapping
alternatives: solo piano pastoral with light strings
chamber folk with mandolin and soft pad

scenes.score_intent: Intimate nocturnal chamber cue, low warm strings and soft piano by the library fire, slow 60–70 BPM, contented aristocratic hush with a low sustained cello under Buck at the Judge’s feet, slight outdoor-hardened color in muted horn halfway through without ever leaving the cozy hearth mood, ends on a held soft major chord
scenes.dynamics_arc: Starts subdued on clip 1 and rises only slightly to a modest warm peak on clip 2 before holding steady.
scenes.timing: Continuous low bed across ~25s, tiny swell in second half
scenes.diegetic_sound: Crackling fireplace, clock tick, soft breathing and fabric rustle
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No brass fanfares or rhythmic drive; keep score under dialogue and fire crackle
alternatives: solo cello and sparse piano
soft harmonium and string quartet

scenes.score_intent: Dark suspense underscore turning to violent struggle, low dissonant strings and muted pulse at 70 BPM opening in orchard night shadows, tension coils with dry percussion ticks and uneasy woodwinds as the rope doubles under the collar and money changes hands, tempo and density climb through the choke bargain lines, then erupts in the final third into frantic string tremolo, harsh brass stabs and pounding low drums as Buck springs in rage and the rope tightens mercilessly until a choking cut-down leaves ringing near-silence
scenes.dynamics_arc: Builds from uneasy clip 1 through rope and bargain clips 2–4, peaks violently on the choke and rage at clip 5, then collapses.
scenes.timing: Slow dread 0–20s, tightening mid-scene, full eruption final ~12–15s of the 50s scene
scenes.diegetic_sound: Night insects, rope rasp on collar, coin chink, Buck’s growl and thrash, choked gasps, body thud
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Drop score almost to nothing after the choke so gasps and night air dominate the button
alternatives: minimal heartbeat pulse into noise burst
solo low strings with sudden cluster hit

scenes.score_intent: Urgent nocturnal industrial train cue, iron-heavy low brass and driving percussion at 110–120 BPM, opens already hot as the unconscious Buck is thrown into the baggage car, locomotive shriek integrated as a screaming lead over gathering wheel rhythm, then propulsive ostinato carries the train into the night with a slight release as distance grows but never fully calm
scenes.dynamics_arc: Peaks immediately on the throw into the car at clip 1, then rides a slightly lower but still driving intensity through the departing train on clip 2.
scenes.timing: Hard attack from frame one, sustained drive across ~15s with minor tail-off
scenes.diegetic_sound: Body slam on wood floor, baggage-door slam, locomotive whistle shriek, crossing bell, wheels accelerating on rails
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No pastoral residue from earlier scenes; keep music subordinate to whistle and wheel roar at the shriek
alternatives: percussion-only rail rhythm with whistle
dark synth pulse under pure train FX

scenes.score_intent: Claustrophobic rage-to-simmer score for baggage car and crate prison, jagged strings and metallic percussion exploding at 100+ BPM as Buck’s eyes open with unbridled fury and jaws close, then drops to wary sparse cues under the handlers’ casual talk, rebuilds with grinding low brass and scraped textures as the brass collar is filed off, and climbs again into a brooding wounded-pride swell of angry cellos and distant drum hits as Buck nurses wrath in the crate, joyful bark twisting toward a savage growl without full release
scenes.dynamics_arc: Opens at peak fury on clip 1, dips through dialogue clips 2–3, rises on collar filing clip 4, and surges again to a secondary high on crate wrath clip 5.
scenes.timing: Violent cold open 0–10s, thin underscore mid 10–30s, dark rebuild final 15s of ~45s
scenes.diegetic_sound: Jolting car wheels, snarl and bite, cry of mangled hand, file on brass collar, crate wood slam, saloon murmur, tallow-candle hiss
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Pull music way down under spoken lines in clips 2–3 so dialogue reads clean
alternatives: industrial drones with sudden sting hits
string quartet aggression into hollow crate reverb

scenes.score_intent: Brutal primitive-law combat score evolving into hard-won stillness, dry war drums and snarling low strings at a heavy 90 BPM as the crate opens in the Seattle yard, tension ratchets on the red-eyed taunts, then detonates into full orchestral-percussion violence—tom battery, brass shocks, and grinding ostinatos—through Buck’s mid-air launch, dozen smashed charges, and the deliberate frightful nose blow at the apex, collapses with a held dissonant chord as he crumples, stays thin and hollow under the breaker’s genial talk and meat-and-water mercy, then settles into a cold resolved minor-pad lesson motif as other crated dogs arrive, beaten-but-not-broken dignity in sparse piano and low drone
scenes.dynamics_arc: Rises from clips 1–3, hits maximum on the launch and nose-blow climax across clips 4–6, stays high through the knockout clip 7, then releases sharply through clips 8–9 and holds a subdued reflective plateau across clips 10–19.
scenes.timing: Build 0–15s, sustained combat peak ~15–40s of 70s scene, long subdued aftermath final half
scenes.diegetic_sound: Hatchet on crate, Buck’s charges and roars, club impacts, blood and slaver, body crumple, water pour, raw meat, crate arrivals, rope drag, coin pass, red-sweater man’s calm voice
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: After knockout, strip score to near silence under dialogue clips 8–16 so words and breathing dominate; no heroic triumph brass
alternatives: taiko and distorted cello combat into empty wind
percussion-only fight then solo mournful horn

scenes.score_intent: Transitional bargaining cue with northern frontier color, light accordion and plucked strings at easy 85 BPM, a brief bright exclamation on Sacredam praise of the bully dog, settles into practical deal-making underscore under the three-hundred price and government-money lines, then a clean forward-moving walk motif as Buck and Curly are led away from the red sweater toward the next chapter
scenes.dynamics_arc: Highest on the opening bargain exclamation clip 1, eases through price talk clips 2–3, and softens further on the lead-away clip 4.
scenes.timing: Small accent at open, steady bed through ~30s, gentle lift into exit walk
scenes.diegetic_sound: Yard ambience, dog tags and leash jingle, boot steps, faint distant harbor
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No combat residue; keep light under French-accented dialogue
alternatives: spare fiddle and hand drum
quiet military snare brush with accordion

scenes.score_intent: Maritime voyage score turning colder and stranger, rolling cello ostinato and ship-board woodwinds at 75 BPM over receding Seattle, denser tween-decks texture as Buck meets Spitz and Dave, sharp stinger and whip-crack accent when Spitz steals food and Buck springs, then long cold drone and thinning harmony as day and night the ship throbs north, atmosphere brightens with anticipatory high strings when the propeller stills, and ends on crystalline sparse piano and glass-harmonic shimmer as first snow falls and Buck licks the biting white stuff
scenes.dynamics_arc: Moderate open clips 1–2, peaks on the food-steal spring clip 3, drops to cold endurance clip 4, lifts with arrival excitement clip 5, and settles curious-soft on first snow clip 6.
scenes.timing: Rolling bed 0–15s, sharp mid conflict accent, cold stretch, brightening final third of ~45s
scenes.diegetic_sound: Hull creak, propeller throb, dog growls and whip sing, wind rising, propeller stilling, soft snow hush, Buck’s sniff and lick, onlookers’ laugh
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Leave space for whip crack and laughs; thin score under snow so flakes and lick read clearly
alternatives: foghorn drone and sparse guitar
Nordic hardanger fiddle over ship pulse

scenes.score_intent: Primordial ecstasy and death-duel score, opening with moonlit chase energy—racing strings, pack-cry choir, and leaping percussion at climbing tempo as Buck leads the rabbit hunt in flashing leaps; swells into transcendent full-orchestral ecstasy marking the summit of life, old wolf-cry vocalise soaring as he goes back into the womb of Time; snaps into brutal intimate fight music when Spitz cuts in—shoulder-crash drums, fang-clash metallic hits, streaming blood string scrapes—building through thrice-more attacks and the broken-foreleg crunch to a final catastrophic shoulder-to-shoulder impact and dark-circle frenzy that swallows Spitz, then cuts to a stark victorious silence broken only by a single low dominant-beast drone as Buck stands alone champion under the aurora
scenes.dynamics_arc: High chase lift (clip 1) rising through pack-lead ecstasy (clips 2-5), sharp turn at rabbit kill (clip 6), absolute sustained peak across the death fight (clips 7-10), releases to solitary champion aftermath (clip 11).
scenes.timing: 75s scene; ecstatic chase build first 40%, fight detonation and sustained brutal peak middle 40%, stark champion release final 20%
scenes.diegetic_sound: Snowshoe rabbit dash, sixty-dog pack cry, leaping snow crunch, rabbit shriek, shoulder impacts, fang on fang, blood drip on snow, breaking bone, pack circle snarl, final heavy breath in moonlit quiet
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Hard cut to near-silence the instant Spitz vanishes under the circle so Buck's lone stance lands in emptiness; no triumphant brass victory theme—keep it raw and primordial
alternatives: tribal drum and throat-sing duel only
string-quartet violence morphing from ecstasy fugue to death stabs

scenes.score_intent: Northern frontier orchestral underscore with dry fiddle, low frame-drum and muted horns under camp dialogue at a steady ~90 BPM, sparse and watchful through the Spitz talk, then cellos and snare tighten as Buck drives Sol-leks from the lead; percussion and brass swell through the club-chase and curses, circling tension held just out of reach, until the club hits the snow and the cue breaks into a bright triumphant horn call and laughing sled-dog rhythm as Buck trots into the lead
scenes.dynamics_arc: Holds moderate through dialogue clips 1–4, rises through the leadership revolt and club chase clips 5–8, dips at the thrown-down club clip 9, peaks in triumphant lead claim clip 10.
scenes.timing: ~50s; stay under dialogue first third, surge with action mid-to-late, resolve on the lead takeover
scenes.diegetic_sound: dog snarls and snaps, club whooshes, men’s curses, harness jingle, paws on packed snow
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: leave clear pockets under Francois/Perrault lines; no cartoon stings on every shove
alternatives: percussion-and-breath tribal standoff bed
wind-heavy ambient with sparse drum hits only on charges

scenes.score_intent: Propulsive Yukon adventure score at brisk ~120 BPM built on sled-bell ostinato, driving strings and confident brass motifs for Buck’s leadership, rhythmic punches as he shakes Pike and smothers Joe, team-unison surge as Teek and Koona are broken in, then full orchestral momentum and soaring horns cresting as the team flies the lakes with the running man towed behind into Skaguay
scenes.dynamics_arc: Strong open clip 1, early peak on discipline clip 2, eases on new dogs clip 3, rebuilds through praise clip 4 to velocity peak on the lake run clip 5.
scenes.timing: ~40s; continuous forward motion, lift into final third for the record-run payoff
scenes.diegetic_sound: runners hissing, breath and pant of dogs, whip cracks, ice echo, distant trail shouts
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: thin under Francois praise line so the spoken boast reads; avoid drowning tow-rope visuals
alternatives: leaner snare-and-fiddle courier march
synth-pulse hybrid race cue with orchestral overlay

scenes.score_intent: Bittersweet farewell cue at slow ~70 BPM, warm mid strings and lonely harmonica over soft crowd bed, swelling emotional cello and hushed choir-like pads as Francois throws his arms around Buck and weeps openly, then thinning to spare woodwinds and a colder distant drum as official orders end their run and the Scotch half-breed takes the heavy mail load out
scenes.dynamics_arc: Warm crowd open clip 1, peaks on Francois weeping embrace clip 2, releases through orders and new-driver departure clips 3–4.
scenes.timing: ~30s; emotional crest mid-scene on the embrace, quick cool-down into mail departure
scenes.diegetic_sound: street crowd murmur, dog-buster chatter, harness clink, boots on boardwalk, mail sacks thudding
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: drop almost to silence under the weeping so sobs and fabric read; no heroic fanfare on the handoff
alternatives: solo accordion lament with string pad
near-diegetic street band fading to wind

scenes.score_intent: Dark nocturnal mail-trail score opening with hypnotic low drone and machine-like muted percussion at ~75 BPM for monotonous toil, dissolving into eerie ethereal flutes, bone rattles and distant tribal pulse as the fire becomes the hairy-man vision and beast eyes gleam two by two, snapped by a sharp wake-up hit, then grim heavy strings and funeral-march timpani climb through Dave’s pride-sickness and final harness run, cresting in a stark held chord that cuts to near silence around the offscreen mercy shot
scenes.dynamics_arc: Low machine grind clips 1–2, rises through vision clips 3–4, resets at wake-up clip 5, climbs through Dave’s decline clips 6–7 to peak at the mercy-shot aftermath clip 8.
scenes.timing: ~60s; dream middle third floats free of tempo, tragedy final third slow and inevitable
scenes.diegetic_sound: fire crackle, night wind, trace chains, Dave’s falls and bites, distant revolver shot, team’s knowing stillness
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: hard near-silence after the shot; no melodic resolution—let the gun and the knowing dogs land
alternatives: pure ambient fire-and-drone dream without tribal colors
minimal piano tolls over wind for Dave’s end only

scenes.score_intent: Weary arrival underscore turning ironic and faintly comic-ominous, thin tired strings at slow ~65 BPM for the wretched starved mail team tottering into Skaguay, dry woodblock and awkward banjo-tinged frontier colors as callow Hal, watery-eyed Charles and pretty soft Mercedes enter, skeptical light pizzicato under ignored neighbor advice and the top-heavy tent-and-dishes argument, unsettled foolish mood rather than heroic
scenes.dynamics_arc: Flat moderate plateau across clips 1–6 with a slight dip on soft Mercedes intro clip 3; no true climax, steady uneasy tone.
scenes.timing: ~40s; even bed under introductions and load debate, no big swell
scenes.diegetic_sound: street noise, starved dog pants, crate and dish clatter, Mercedes’ flutters, neighbors’ grins and asides
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: keep music thin under all spoken advice and Mercedes’ undreamed-of tent line
alternatives: almost silent practical bed with occasional wry clarinet
out-of-tune parlor piano for the greenhorns

scenes.score_intent: Chaotic slapstick-to-danger frontier cue at ~100 BPM, busy percussion and frantic fiddles as fourteen dogs tangle against frozen runners, lighter winds under Mercedes’ poor-dears protests, then an explosive orchestral hit and chaotic brass as angry Buck breaks into a raging run, trips Hal and capsizes the top-heavy sled across the thoroughfare, settling into wry subdued strings while kind citizens catch dogs and advise half the load and twice the dogs
scenes.dynamics_arc: Builds through overload and break-out struggle clips 1–3, peaks violently on the raging capsize clip 4, releases to calmer aftermath advice clip 5.
scenes.timing: ~45s; ratchet mid-scene, hard accent on spill, quick deflate after
scenes.diegetic_sound: whip wrenches, frozen runner scrapes, dog pile snarls, sled crash and scatter, citizen shouts
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: duck under Mercedes’ Oh Hal line and the citizens’ half-load advice
alternatives: cartoon-percussion spill then dry realism
tight rhythmic tension without comedy colors

scenes.score_intent: Bleak tragic trail dirge at dragging ~60 BPM, hollow winds and gaunt strings for slovenly half-night camps and poor mileage, sudden harsh brass and percussion stabs when Outside dogs are shot with the Colt and Billee is axed, grinding dissonant textures under the unending family quarrel and Mercedes riding, thinning to skeletal near-silent strings and a weak heartbeat drum as seven perambulating skeletons stagger with Buck blind-weak at the head keeping trail by loom and feel
scenes.dynamics_arc: Low incompetent open clip 1, peaks on the dog-killings clip 2, settles through horse-hide and quarrel clips 3–4, rises again in weary despair on the skeleton team clip 5.
scenes.timing: ~55s; brutal accents mid-early, long starved decay through final third
scenes.diegetic_sound: ax and revolver, starving whines, sled creak, endless bickering voices, stumbling paws, wind over crust
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: strip music almost bare on the final stagger so breath and limp legs dominate; no sentimental swell on deaths
alternatives: solo bowed saw and wind only
low electronic pulse under naturalistic cruelty

scenes.score_intent: Spring-light pastoral open with gentle woodwinds and thawing-water textures at easy ~80 BPM over sap and birds, darkening as whip then club fall on unmoving Buck with brutal percussion hits and strained climbing strings, exploding into raw heroic brass and furious timpani on Thornton’s animal cry and death-threat If you strike that dog again I’ll kill you, holding knife-edge tension through Hal’s protest and the cut traces, a cold suspended chord as the party pulls onto rotten ice and the section gives way into a yawning hole, resolving to tender solo cello and quiet guitar as Thornton says You poor devil and Buck licks his hand
scenes.dynamics_arc: Gentle rise through arrival and warning clips 1–5, surges to peak on Thornton’s kill-threat clip 7, stays high through Hal’s defiance clip 8 and ice-collapse clip 9, releases into compassion on clip 10.
scenes.timing: ~70s; pastoral first fifth, violence and standoff center, ice sting then long soft resolve
scenes.diegetic_sound: spring birds and melt water, whip/club impacts, Thornton’s cry, knife on club, traces cut, ice groan and splash, Buck’s weak lick
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: near silence under You poor devil and the hand-lick; do not score the ice hole with a horror sting—cold suspension only
alternatives: spare Copland-esque open fifths into sudden violence
minimal piano and breath, diegetic-led rescue

scenes.score_intent: Warm intimate acoustic wilderness-camp score, soft fingerpicked guitar and gentle strings opening hushed and sparse at a slow 70 BPM as Buck rests through long spring days and is tended by Skeet and Nig, gradually swelling with tender cello and light woodwinds as genuine passionate love awakens for the first time, tempo and warmth climbing through the middle into a heartfelt lyrical swell of full warm strings and soft brass at the head-between-hands love-name climax and Buck’s laughing spring, then easing into quiet nocturnal intimacy with sparse piano and distant night air as he adores at a distance and creeps to the tent flap to listen
scenes.dynamics_arc: Intensity rises gently from quiet convalescence (clips 1–3) through awakening love (clips 4–6), peaks at the rough affectionate head-hold and joyful spring (clips 7–8), then softens through hand-caress and distant adoration into hushed night vigil (clips 9–12).
scenes.timing: Sparse underscore first ~20s; steady emotional swell through mid-scene love beats; lyrical peak around clips 7–8; taper to near-minimal night bed over final clips
scenes.diegetic_sound: Soft camp ambience, spring river hush, dog breathing and gentle washing sounds, low human murmurs, tent canvas and night insects under final beat
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No percussion hits, no suspense stingers, no tribal or hunting drums; keep score subordinate to intimate performance
alternatives: solo piano and warm pad only
string quartet without guitar

scenes.score_intent: Tense frontier orchestral score opening with sly low percussion and muted strings for stealth meat-stealing and camp life, building into a sudden savage brass-and-drum roar neither bark nor yelp for the Circle City bar throat-attack, briefly settling into sparse tense underscore for the miners’ restraint and verdict, then surging into relentless whitewater action with driving strings, pounding timpani and urgent horns as the poling-boat flips and Buck battles the Forty-Mile rapids through tail-grasp and repeated rope launches, exploding into a heroic full-orchestra battering-ram climax on the third launch under the master’s electric voice, then collapsing into exhausted sparse piano and low strings over three broken ribs on the bank
scenes.dynamics_arc: Rises from moderate tension (clips 1–2) to first peak at the bar-attack roar (clip 3), dips through meeting and poling setup (clips 4–5), climbs through rapids rescue (clips 6–10) to equal peak at the third rope launch (clip 11), then releases to quiet aftermath (clip 12).
scenes.timing: Low stealth into sudden hit by ~clip 3; brief reset; continuous escalating action bed through rapids third; hard drop to sparse coda on bank
scenes.diegetic_sound: Bar crowd murmur and strike impact, river roar and snub-line creak, thrashing water, rope whip and gasp, shore gravel and labored breathing
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Mute heroic theme during miners’ meeting dialogue; no music over final medical quiet except thinnest pad
alternatives: percussion-forward survival score without full brass
synth-orchestral hybrid with submerged water textures

scenes.score_intent: Cold Dawson saloon tension building into epic heroic dog-sled triumph, sparse icy piano and low brass murmurs for sixty-below boastful wager talk at a measured 80 BPM, tightening with snare and held strings as the flour-loaded sled is revealed and Thornton kneels cheek-to-cheek whispering As you love me, then erupting into driving rhythmic strings and bold horns as Gee Haw Mush commands crack and Buck breaks the frozen runners free with crisp crackling, climbing relentlessly to a massive orchestral peak—choir-tinged—as muscles writhe and knot and he hauls the thousand-pound load a hundred yards, then releasing into warm triumphant brass and tender strings for the kneeling head-to-head embrace and quiet refusal of the richer offer
scenes.dynamics_arc: Builds from saloon tension (clips 1–3) through the intimate love command (clips 4–6), rises sharply through Gee–Haw–Mush breakout (clips 7–10), peaks as Buck throws himself into the pull (clip 11), sustains high through the hundred yards and embrace (clips 12–13), then eases through refusal and final hand-seize (clips 14–15).
scenes.timing: Dialogue-led sparse bed first third; command cue lifts into continuous pull crescendo mid-to-late; warm release over final celebration beats
scenes.diegetic_sound: Saloon crowd and gold-sack thump, frozen runner crackle, claw-on-ice scrape, sled groan, crowd roar hats-and-mittens, breath and fabric on embrace
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Leave clear pocket for whispered As you love me and the single Mush command; no score competing with final spoken refusal
alternatives: northern folk fiddle and frame-drum build
minimalist pulse with late orchestral bloom only

scenes.score_intent: Expansive wilderness journey score with open acoustic guitar, soft French horn and airy strings at a moderate walking tempo around 90 BPM, pastoral and exploratory through Yukon-to-Stewart bends and Indian-fashion salt-and-rifle hunting, seasons wheeling with subtle color shifts from bright summer textures to colder naked-mountain and sparse lonely flute over the ancient blazed path that begins nowhere, gently brightening into warm hopeful major-key strings and light percussion as spring reveals not the Lost Cabin but a shallow placer of gold like yellow butter and moose-hide sacks heaped like firewood
scenes.dynamics_arc: Steady moderate wandering energy (clips 1–2), dips into sparse lonely wonder on seasons and the ancient path (clips 3–4), rises to a gentle peak at the placer-gold discovery (clip 5).
scenes.timing: Even traveling bed across first ~30s; thin to near-solo colors on path beat; soft lift and resolve on final placer reveal
scenes.diegetic_sound: River and pack-creak travel, rifle once, wind on peaks, insects or soft snow, shovel-gravel and sack settle on placer
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No action percussion, no dark dread drones; avoid overscoring quiet travel montages
alternatives: solo horn and ambient nature bed
string orchestra without guitar

scenes.score_intent: Mystical nocturnal wilderness score opening with low drone and soft firelit strings as Buck muses idle days and hairy-man visions, the forest call entering as distant wordless choir and lonely horn that fills him with unrest, building with restless percussion and rising strings as he springs mane-bristling to the timber-wolf howl, chasing through urgent rhythmic strings and wild flute into a free soaring mid-tempo run, softening to intimate curious woodwinds at the nose-sniff and nervous half-friendly play by the stream, then a tender warm-cello pull of remembered Thornton that turns him home under a mournful fading howl, peaking again in joyful frantic affection as he plays the general tom-fool, settling to protective quiet underscore for two days never leaving camp
scenes.dynamics_arc: Rises from idle musing (clips 1–2) through night howl and chase to a peak at the wild leapings pursuit (clip 5), eases through play and stream memory (clips 6–7), peaks again in affectionate frenzy (clip 8), then settles to watchful calm (clip 9).
scenes.timing: Hypnotic sparse open; call and chase carry mid-scene; brief intimate dip; second warm spike on tom-fool; soft hold to end
scenes.diegetic_sound: Fire crackle, deep forest howl, paw-fall and brush, stream trickle, camp night quiet, playful scuffle on return
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No modern rhythmic traps; keep howl diegetic dominant over scored howls when on-screen
alternatives: pure ambient choir and frame drum
chamber strings with solo clarinet call motif

scenes.score_intent: Primeval hunting score of raw power, deep drums and growling low brass under proud soaring strings as Buck in full flower—glorious coat, wolf-like—cuts a great bull from a band of twenty moose, patient tense ostinatos stretching through half-day multiplication and four-day siege with relentless quiet intensity never permitting browse or drink, a savage triumphant percussion crest when the bull falls, then shifting on the long easy lope home into ominous dissonant strings and hollow drums as calamity scent lifts neck hair, darkening through grief-struck sparse motifs over Nig arrow-dead and a sled-dog thrashing in death-struggle into a horrified rage-swelling climax of pounding brass as Hans lies feathered like a porcupine at the edge of the wrecked clearing
scenes.dynamics_arc: Builds from proud power (clips 1–2) through patient hunt (clip 3) to a high peak at the four-day kill (clip 4), eases on the homeward lope (clip 5), then climbs through discoveries of the dead (clips 6–7) to equal peak of rage at Hans and the clearing (clip 8).
scenes.timing: Proud theme into stretched tense hunt bed; kill crest mid-scene; color shift to dread on return trail; continuous dark rise through body discoveries to final clearing hit
scenes.diegetic_sound: Moose crash and breath, forest silence under patience, flies or leaves on corpses, arrow-shaft creak, distant unsettled camp hush
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Strip music to almost nothing on first sight of Nig’s body so diegetic horror leads; no triumphant fanfare after kill
alternatives: tribal drum and throat-drone only
string tremolo horror without brass

scenes.score_intent: Brutal vengeful orchestral fury opening at full intensity with savage war drums, screaming brass and violent string ostinatos as Buck erupts upon Yeehats dancing about the wreckage of the spruce-bough lodge, sustaining maximum ferocity through chief throat-rip and plunging mid-midst tearing rending destruction with chaotic percussion and dissonant clusters, then fracturing into panicked fleeing motifs as the tribe scatters proclaiming the Evil Spirit, collapsing abruptly into hollow devastated silence and sparse mourning solo cello over the desolated camp and Pete killed in his blankets, deepening into cold empty grief with low sustained strings and distant wind as Buck finds Thornton by the pool head and forefeet in the water and broods the void all day with pride at having killed man
scenes.dynamics_arc: Opens at maximum fury and sustains through the massacre (clips 1–3), slightly eases through panicked flight (clip 4), then drops sharply into devastated quiet over the dead and the pool (clips 5–6), holding low brooding intensity (clip 7).
scenes.timing: Immediate full-intensity attack through first ~half; fracture and scatter bridge; hard cut to near-silence and thin mourning bed for discovery and brood
scenes.diegetic_sound: War-cries cut short, flesh and weapon clatter, fleeing shouts, lodge wreckage settle, water lap at pool, wind through empty camp
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: After massacre, exclude drums and brass entirely; leave long unscoreable air around Thornton’s body reveal
alternatives: percussion-and-choir vengeance then solo voice lament
atonal cluster attack into pure ambient void

scenes.score_intent: Moonlit mythic finale score opening with ethereal high strings and ghostly choir over full-moon stillness bathing the land in ghostly day, pack yelps entering as layered wolf-howl textures and low drums as the silvery flood pours into the clearing where Buck stands statue-still, exploding into fierce combat music with snapping percussion and aggressive brass as the boldest wolf leaps and Buck breaks its neck then holds the pell-mell crowded pack at bay from a gravel-bank angle, thinning to tense exhausted breathing space with sparse held tones as wolves draw back tongues lolling, warming into cautious friendly woodwinds as the long lean gray advances and the old gaunt battle-scarred wolf comes forward, rising into a solemn communal howl of acceptance with full choir and horns as Buck comes out and the pack crowds sniffing, then releasing into free running wild joy as he joins side by side with his wild brother under the moon—last tie broken
scenes.dynamics_arc: Builds from ghostly moonrise (clip 1) through pack arrival (clip 2) to combat peaks as Buck fights the boldest and the whole pack (clips 3–4), releases through discomfit and cautious approach (clips 5–6), rises again at the old-wolf howl and pack acceptance into the run (clips 7–8).
scenes.timing: Ethereal open ~first 10–15s; combat surge mid-scene; thinned standoff; acceptance howl and run carry final third to open ending
scenes.diegetic_sound: Night wind and moonlit quiet, pack yelp chorus, snarl and body impact, gravel scramble, sniff and breath, communal howl, running paws into forest
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No human-instrument hero theme after acceptance; let diegetic howl lead the join; avoid unresolved dissonance on final run
alternatives: voice-and-drum ritual pack score
orchestral with prominent solo horn wolf motif

scenes.score_intent: Cinematic wilderness epilogue score, primal and mythic: opens hushed and sparse with low sustained strings, distant frame-drum pulse and cold night-wind textures around 60 BPM as moonlit valley and altered wolves appear; tension coils with darker cello ostinatos and muted horn stabs into a sudden predatory surge for the night-raid wolf-shape; eases into pale mournful solo horn and sparse piano over thin high strings for the snowy dead hunters and the forbidden valley; summer gold-stream passage stays intimate and elegiac with a single aching cello line and soft choir pad; then the Ghost Dog lifts his head and the score begins a long inexorable climb—tempo rising toward 95–100 BPM, full low brass, taiko and wolf-howl-blended choir entering—as winter moonlight and borealis break open into a gigantic leaping pack anthem, great throat a-bellow, peaking on the final image of the Ghost Dog at the head of the pack under pale sky before a resonant held chord and fade into wind
scenes.dynamics_arc: Quiet legend-building through clips 1–2 rises sharply to a predatory peak at clip 3, releases across aftermath and summer solitude (clips 4–7), then climbs from the howl at clip 8 through winter night (9) to the scene’s highest intensity on the full-run and pack-leader finale (clips 10–11).
scenes.timing: Sparse atmospheric bed for first ~15s (clips 1–2); brief aggressive swell ~clips 3–4; mournful thin texture through mid-section summer beats; sustained build from clip 8 onward, full anthem in final third, resonant decay on last image
scenes.diegetic_sound: Night wind over valley, distant wolf howls, snow crunch and camp-raid scuffles, trap-chain rattle, throat-slash silence then greater paw-prints in snow, soft summer stream trickle, single long mournful howl, winter pack howls blending into score, breath and snow under giant paws
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No jaunty or civilized instrumentation; avoid dense percussion under summer gold-stream solitude; leave clean air after the mournful howl before winter rise; no dialogue bed
